artworks.title: West Pediment of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (Centauromachy)
artworks.description: Olympia's west pediment — Apollo calm above the Lapith wedding brawl, Eurytion's outrage carved as order versus chaos.

artworks.title: The Battle of the Lapiths and Centaurs
artworks.description: Jordaens' Baroque tumult — Centaurs seize brides, Lapiths strike back, Hippodameia's feast wrecked at the centre.

artworks.title: Combat of the Centaurs and the Lapiths
artworks.description: Bouguereau's Salon machine — bodies mid-struggle from Ovid's Metamorphoses XII, the Centauromachy as academic proof.

artworks.title: Perithoos and Hippodameia
artworks.description: Attic volute-krater — Peirithous leads Hippodameia as bride while Lapiths and Centaurs explode into the wedding fight.

artworks.title: The Abduction of Hippodamia
artworks.description: Bronze group — a Centaur rears with Hippodameia locked against his chest, the seizure that ignites the Lapith war.

popCulture.title: Centauromachy
popCulture.description: The wedding brawl of Pirithous — Lapiths against Centaurs — carved on the Parthenon and every classical frieze of order versus chaos.

popCulture.title: Lapiths
popCulture.description: The Thessalian hosts of the fatal feast — Theseus among them when the Centaurs seize the brides.
